products.name: DaVinci Resolve AI
products.note: Professional video AI; color grading; facial recognition; local processing option

profile_text.body:
Blackmagic Design is a hardware and software manufacturer focused on the feature film, post-production, and broadcast industries. Its product line spans cinema cameras such as the URSA series, live production switchers under the ATEM brand, video capture and playback devices, network storage solutions, and professional audio mixing software. The company describes itself as creating "the world's highest quality products" for these markets, with recent releases emphasizing high-bandwidth connectivity standards including 100G Ethernet and SMPTE-2110 IP video workflows.

The company's primary AI product is DaVinci Resolve AI, a professional video editing and color grading application that incorporates AI-assisted features including facial recognition and color grading tools, with a local processing option. DaVinci Resolve 21 is noted among the company's current software offerings alongside Fairlight Live, its software-based live audio mixer with support for SMPTE-2110 broadcast and immersive workflows.

The held facts confirm Blackmagic Design has an active profile on theworldofai.org with DaVinci Resolve AI tracked under the Video Generation and Editing category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
